boards.title: Your First Weekend at Taylor University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A gentle, under-21-safe first-weekend loop through Taylor’s named campus spaces, mixing orientation, food, reflection, and places to return to with new friends.

cards.title: Get your bearings from the campus map
cards.subtitle: Start with the named buildings and landmarks
cards.notes: Open the official map before heading out, then choose two or three marked destinations to recognize in person as you walk campus.
cards.short_summary: A practical first loop that makes the rest of the weekend easier to navigate.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor’s January 2026 official campus map identifies academic, athletic, residential, and miscellaneous campus destinations.
cards.access_notes: Use the official map for current names and locations; individual building access may vary.

cards.title: Meet over a meal at Hodson
cards.subtitle: Taylor’s main dining location
cards.notes: Pick a table with your orientation group or new hallmates and leave time for introductions before continuing the campus loop.
cards.short_summary: A built-in meal stop for meeting people without making elaborate plans.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor identifies Hodson Dining Commons as its main dining location and says it offers continuous dining until 8 pm.
cards.access_notes: Meals use the applicable meal plan, swipe, ticket, or guest purchase arrangement; confirm current dining service.

cards.title: Find the café in the library galleria
cards.subtitle: Zondervan Library Galleria
cards.notes: Locate Zondy’s during your library visit so you know a named campus café option when you need a short, casual meetup later.
cards.short_summary: A simple landmark to pair with a first library visit.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor Dining lists Zondy’s Cafe in the Zondervan Library Galleria as a campus meal option.
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks require payment or an applicable campus dining arrangement; verify current service availability.

cards.title: Make Zondervan Library your return point
cards.subtitle: Central campus library
cards.notes: Walk through the library and note the service desk, study areas, and café galleria so you have a familiar place to regroup later.
cards.short_summary: A central academic landmark with research help available to students.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor describes Zondervan Library as central to campus and states that librarians and student research assistants can help students begin research or find resources.
cards.access_notes: Check current building and library access information before visiting outside normal hours.

cards.title: Pause in the Euler atrium
cards.subtitle: Euler Science Complex
cards.notes: Use the large atrium as a visible meeting point, then take a few minutes to identify the science complex and its connection to campus.
cards.short_summary: A spacious named campus stop that works well between activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor states that the Euler Science Complex is its largest single building and includes a large atrium and the Nussbaum Center.
cards.access_notes: Building access can vary by day and time; follow posted access rules.

cards.title: Take a quiet moment at Memorial Prayer Chapel
cards.subtitle: Prayer chapel and gardens
cards.notes: Step through the atrium, notice the prayer alcoves and gardens, and keep the visit low-key if others are using the chapel for reflection.
cards.short_summary: A designated prayer space with indoor and garden elements.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor says Memorial Prayer Chapel was built specifically for prayer and includes a 75-seat chapel, atrium, prayer alcoves, and prayer gardens.
cards.access_notes: Respect any quiet-use, service, or building-access guidance posted on site.

cards.title: See the Boren Art Gallery collection
cards.subtitle: Helena Memorial Hall
cards.notes: Enter through Helena Hall’s main entrance and give yourselves time to view the permanent collection and whichever exhibition is currently installed.
cards.short_summary: A free, named campus gallery with Western and Indiana art collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor states that Boren Art Gallery in Helena Memorial Hall houses the Boren Western Art and Indiana Art collections, and that admittance is free.
cards.access_notes: The gallery lists Wednesday 12–5 pm during the academic year, with Monday and Friday visits by appointment.

cards.title: Walk out to Taylor Lake
cards.subtitle: Eight-acre campus lake
cards.notes: Use the lakeside as a slower outdoor leg of the weekend; stay on appropriate campus paths and leave water activities for authorized conditions.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus landscape feature beside Hodson Dining Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor’s campus facilities catalog describes Taylor Lake as an eight-acre lake on campus and notes its use for ecology studies.
cards.access_notes: Observe posted campus safety guidance and do not enter the water unless an authorized activity permits it.

cards.title: Locate the Kesler Student Activities Center
cards.subtitle: KSAC recreation and athletics space
cards.notes: Add KSAC to your mental map, then check its current postings or campus channels for student recreation and athletics opportunities.
cards.short_summary: A named facility that combines recreation, athletics, and kinesiology classroom space.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor states that the Kesler Student Activities Center provides recreation, athletics, and classroom space for kinesiology classes.
cards.access_notes: Facility access, programs, and equipment availability can vary; follow current campus directions.

cards.title: End at Rediger Chapel & Auditorium
cards.subtitle: LaRita Boren Campus Center
cards.notes: Finish the loop by finding Rediger inside the campus center and checking the current calendar for an appropriate public chapel or performance.
cards.short_summary: A major campus gathering venue for chapel, performances, and student events.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor states that Rediger Chapel & Auditorium, located in LaRita Boren Campus Center, hosts campus chapels, dance competitions, talent shows, and other events.
cards.access_notes: Attend only events open to you and verify the current calendar, entry requirements, and venue access.
